_default_mode.first_application: Apply phosphorus and potassium fertilizers including ½ of nitrogen at planting.
_default_mode.second_application: Sidedress with remaining nitrogen fertilizer at the appropriate growth stage.
_default_mode.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Ampalaya.first_application: Mix the fertilizer with the soil at planting time.
Ampalaya.second_application: Sidedress the fertilizer when the first set of fruit begin to form.
Ampalaya.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Beans (Soybean).first_application: Apply the fertilizer in bands 5.0-7.5 cm to the side and 2.5-5 cm below the level of the seeds, or apply the fertilizer as soon as the vines reach a height of one (1) meter.
Beans (Soybean).organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Cassava.first_application: Apply ½ of nitrogen with all phosphorus and potassium fertilizers in the furrow during planting.
Cassava.second_application: Sidedress the remaining ½ nitrogen fertilizer 2-3 months after planting during hilling up.
Cassava.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Corn.first_application: Apply ½ of nitrogen with all phosphorus and potassium fertilizers in a band 5.0 cm to the side and 5.0 cm below the seed at planting.
Corn.second_application: Sidedress the remaining ½ nitrogen fertilizer when the plants are about four (4) weeks old or about knee high.
Corn.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Eggplant.first_application: Apply ½ of nitrogen with all phosphorus and potassium fertilizers in the furrow at transplanting.
Eggplant.second_application: Topdress ¼ of nitrogen fertilizer one (1) month after transplanting.
Eggplant.third_application: Repeat topdressing with the remaining ¼ of nitrogen after the second harvest of marketable fruits.
Eggplant.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Sorghum.first_application: Apply half of all fertilizers (N, P, K) in the furrow at planting.
Sorghum.second_application: Apply the remaining half of all fertilizers a month after planting.
Sorghum.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Squash.first_application: Mix ½ of nitrogen with all phosphorus and potassium fertilizers with the soil at planting time.
Squash.second_application: Sidedress the remaining ½ nitrogen fertilizer when fruits begin to form.
Squash.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Tomato.first_application: Apply all nitrogen with phosphorus and potassium fertilizers 7.0 cm away from the base of the plant and 7.0 cm deeper than the root system before or at planting.
Tomato.second_application: Sidedress ½ of nitrogen fertilizer when the plants start to bloom or when there are small fruits developing. Repeat after every two weeks.
Tomato.note: Tomatoes are sensitive to too heavy application of N and may result in delayed ripening of fruits that are soft and split easily.
Tomato.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Tobacco.first_application: Apply ½ of nitrogen with all phosphorus and potassium fertilizers 7 cm to the side and 5 cm below the plant at transplanting.
Tobacco.second_application: Dissolve the remaining ½ nitrogen fertilizer in water and apply 7-10 days after transplanting.
Tobacco.note: Avoid using fertilizer that contains chlorides.
Tobacco.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.

Sweet Pepper.first_application: Apply ⅔ of nitrogen with all phosphorus and ½ of potassium fertilizer during the last operation in the land preparation, preferably along the row.
Sweet Pepper.second_application: Sidedress the remaining ⅓ of nitrogen with the remaining ½ potassium fertilizer when the first set of fruits appear.
Sweet Pepper.organic_fertilizer: Apply 14 days to 1 month before planting.
